weather_report:
Subiaco wakes to a quiet, damp hush; a soft belt of cloud keeps the stars at bay and the streets hold a new sheen. Light rain is due around dawn and into the morning, the sort that taps politely on awnings and softens every edge. Sunshine will be shy early, with UV gentle before breakfast; if the cloud thins later, expect a brighter turn and a livelier UV under any patch of blue, but the day looks more muted than blazing. Visibility will feel close and pearly rather than crisp, the air rinsed and cool, the mood unhurried.

Dress for a mild, drizzly start: a light waterproof or trench over easy layers, closed shoes that don’t mind puddles, and a compact umbrella you won’t resent carrying. This is a day for small, useful pleasures—an early coffee at a window seat, a quick library visit, a tidy-up of the desk, a grocery run between showers, or a tram-stop stroll once the rain slackens. If the sky brightens later, slip out for a gentle walk and let the damp gardens steam; bring sunglasses and a dab of sunscreen just in case the sun decides to put in a brief, sharper cameo.
